clarity.justification: The method closely targets the hypothesis: it proposes to rank heads by alignment with an “uncertainty” direction, test their causal role using “path patching,” and measure whether intervention causes “reduction in subsequent reflection markers and total tokens” without changing answers. The prediction is directional and partly quantified by the expectation of “25-40% token reduction at equal accuracy,” so failing to achieve that reduction at preserved accuracy is a decidable refuting outcome; the distributed-head possibility is also explicitly acknowledged as weakening the compact-circuit claim. However, “small set,” “equal accuracy,” and the criterion for declaring a head-to-token path causal are not numerically defined, while the phrase “positions where loop-driver heads previously wrote” leaves some ambiguity about how head-specific information is separated after it has entered a shared residual stream.

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is to “patch the loop-driver-head outputs ... specifically along the path to reflection-token query positions”; edge/path patching is implementable with transformer hooks, but this particular path and the proposed “value-weighted read” require custom attribution and intervention logic rather than a completely standard operation. The named DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen and Qwen2.5 model families and GSM8K, MATH, and ProntoQA datasets exist, and standard PyTorch/TransformerLens-style tooling supports activation capture, head-output scaling, attention editing, and patching, although the exact SEAL/CATS/PathCal implementations are not necessary because the proposal specifies style-based baselines. The refuting branch is runnable because the design includes “random-head and random-position patching controls,” fixed truncation and steering baselines, position-restriction ablations, accuracy measurements, and the possibility that effects are distributed or harm accuracy. Resources are only partly quantified: model sizes of “1.5B/7B” and a “25-40%” target are concrete, but trace counts, prompt counts, temperatures, marker sets, head-selection cutoffs, and replication quantities are unstated.
